name: Jn tail sieve: zeta(gamma) = (6-5*gamma)/4 on gamma in [1, 6/5]
comment: Transcription of fm_exact.py / the constraint inventory (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21220096, Appendix A). Constraint format: [[coeffs on variables], [rhs: const, coeff on gamma]] meaning coeffs.x <= const + c*gamma, all rationals as strings. Fail atoms are negated pass conditions; provenance for every atom is the constraint inventory, sections cited per tool.

FI0.provenance: Fouvry-Iwaniec Thm 6, grouping m1=s; inventory section 6.3

FI1.provenance: Fouvry-Iwaniec Thm 6, grouping m1=mu+s; inventory section 6.3

FI2.provenance: Fouvry-Iwaniec Thm 6, grouping m1=gamma-mu+s; inventory section 6.3

RS0.provenance: Robert-Sargos Thm 1, grouping m1=s; inventory section 4.3

RS1.provenance: Robert-Sargos Thm 1, grouping m1=mu+s; inventory section 4.3

RS2.provenance: Robert-Sargos Thm 1, grouping m1=gamma-mu+s; inventory section 4.3

RS3.provenance: Robert-Sargos Thm 1, grouping m1=gamma+s; inventory section 4.3

ELEM.provenance: Kuzmin-Landau (E1), exponent pair (1/2,1/2) (E2), exponent pair (1/6,2/3) (E3); type I only; single fail option = conjunction of all three negated clauses; inventory section 5

drop-FI-family.note: Paper byproduct: the optimum is unchanged without Fouvry-Iwaniec Thm 6, hence the Coverage Lemma does not need it.
